armour-detail-supply.evidenceSummary: Two coherent automotive-detailing grids pass in opposite viewports. Variant starting prices, kits, tools, towels, chemicals, and size-absent products provide useful extraction and abstention cases. A narrow chat widget partly overlaps one card; the remaining roots are readable and the affected root must be abstained during review.

food-to-live.evidenceSummary: Two visually coherent specialty-food result pages pass in opposite viewports. Large featured products, compact repeated cards, starting prices, flour and whole-grain variants, and absent package sizes create realistic mass extraction and abstention evidence.

medex-supply.evidenceSummary: Two readable medical-supply grids pass in opposite viewports. Titles expose boxes, cases, packs, dimensions, and count suffixes while price ranges and missing sell-unit details supply hard negatives.

spandex-house.evidenceSummary: Two fabric result grids pass in opposite viewports. Width and stretch measurements are prominent physical attributes rather than sell quantities, prices lack explicit per-yard text, and the broad second search includes noisy but genuine product results. A narrow feedback widget partly overlaps two cards; affected evidence must be abstained during review.
